$comment: Advisories the CI security gate is allowed to ignore. See scripts/audit-gate.mjs.
An entry belongs here ONLY when there is no published fix to upgrade or
override to, AND the vulnerable code path is unreachable from this app.
If a patched version exists, pin it via `overrides` in package.json instead —
Every entry needs an `expires` date. On that date the gate starts failing
again, forcing a re-evaluation. That is deliberate: this file must not become
a place where advisories go to be forgotten.

allow.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested brace patterns. No published fix: latest braces (3.0.3) is the vulnerable version. Dev-only path — braces reaches us solely through tailwindcss 3's chokidar/micromatch, where the patterns expanded are our own tailwind.config content globs, never untrusted input.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification accepts malformed signatures. No published fix: latest node-forge (1.4.0) is the vulnerable version. Dev/build toolchain only — reaches us via @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates; nothing in server or client runtime imports node-forge.
